title: Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line Credit Policy on Hold Release, Wind-Down and Closing
content:
**Clause.** A credit hold is released only after every sold-out-of-trust unit is paid off in collected funds and every fee billed is paid. The grade's cash payoff term states that collected funds are required. In wind-down every unit must be paid off within the grade's wind-down payoff period in calendar days; the line closes when the outstanding wholesale principal and the interest due balance are zero.

This clause governs how a Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line leaves a credit hold, how it enters and runs through wind-down, and when it closes. The wind-down period and the cash payoff term are those of the line's Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade.

## Release of a credit hold

The hold is released after every exception is cleared, and the rate after release is recorded on the line. Release is judged on the system record of the line on hold, as it stands before the release, including its interest due balance of billed but unpaid interest and fees.

| Every sold-out-of-trust unit paid off in collected funds | Every fee billed paid | Hold release under this clause |
|---|---|---|
| No | Yes | Not released |
| Yes | No | Not released |
| No | No | Not released |
| Yes | Yes | The conditions of this clause are met |

## Entering wind-down

A line enters wind-down in either of two ways:

- from active, when the dealer gives notice to end the line, or sells or loses the franchise;
- from credit hold, when an uncleared hold is converted to a wind-down.

## Paying off in wind-down and closing

In wind-down every unit must be paid off within the grade's wind-down payoff period, counted in calendar days after wind-down begins. Abstract boundary: a payoff on the last calendar day of that period is within it; a payoff on the following day is not.

The line closes when every financed unit is paid off, its outstanding wholesale principal is zero and its interest due balance is zero; the closing date is then recorded.
